parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description: The device name. If you specify a device name, data for that device is returned. If you do not specify a device name, data for all devices is merged and returned.

parameters.name: DevicePort
parameters.description: The device port. If you specify a port, data for that port is returned. If you do not specify a port, data for all ports is returned. This parameter takes effect only when you specify **DeviceName**.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description: The data granularity in seconds. Valid values are 300 and 3600. The default value is 300 (five minutes). The final granularity also depends on the specified time span.

parameters.name: Isp
parameters.description:
The line to query. To query multiple lines, separate them with commas (,). If you specify multiple lines, the data is aggregated. By default, data for all lines is queried.

Valid values:

- cu: China Unicom.

- cmi: China Mobile.

- ct: China Telecom.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The minimum data granularity is 1 hour.

By default, data from the past 24 hours is read.
